tests.name: AMD CPU
tests.label: CPU Support
tests.description: Checks CPU vendor string via CPUID is "AuthenticAMD"

children.name: Microcode support
children.label: CPU Support
children.description: Verifies processor brand string contains "EPYC" (server-class CPU required)
children.fix_hint: Need AMD EPYC 3rd Gen (Milan) or newer. Consumer Ryzen not supported

children.name: Secure Memory Encryption (SME)
children.label: CPU Support
children.description: Checks CPUID 0x8000001F EAX bit 0 for SME hardware support
children.fix_hint: Use AMD EPYC Naples or newer

children.name: SME
children.message: MSR read failed: Error Reading MSR
children.label: BIOS Configured
children.description: Reads MSR 0xC0010010 (SYSCFG) bit 23 to verify SME enabled at system level
children.fix_hint: Load MSR kernel module: sudo modprobe msr

children.name: Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV)
children.label: CPU Support
children.description: Checks CPUID 0x8000001F EAX bit 1 for SEV hardware support
children.fix_hint: Ensure AMD EPYC processor with SEV support

children.name: SEV Firmware Version
children.message: Failed to get SEV Platform Status unable to open /dev/sev
children.label: BIOS Configured
children.description: Queries /dev/sev PLATFORM_STATUS for firmware version (requires >= 1.51 for SNP)
children.fix_hint: Run with sudo: sudo snphost ok

children.name: Encrypted State (SEV-ES)
children.label: CPU Support
children.description: Checks CPUID 0x8000001F EAX bit 3 for SEV-ES hardware support
children.fix_hint: Use AMD EPYC 2nd Gen (Rome) or newer

children.name: SEV-ES initialized
children.message: Failed to get SEV Platform Status unable to open /dev/sev
children.label: Platform Initialized
children.description: Queries SEV platform status flags bit 8 for SEV-ES initialization
children.fix_hint: Run with sudo: sudo snphost ok

children.name: SEV initialized
children.message: Failed to get SEV Platform Status unable to open /dev/sev
children.label: Platform Initialized
children.description: Queries SEV platform status state field (must be Initialized or Working)
children.fix_hint: Run with sudo: sudo snphost ok

children.name: Secure Nested Paging (SEV-SNP)
children.label: CPU Support
children.description: Checks CPUID 0x8000001F EAX bit 4 for SEV-SNP hardware support
children.fix_hint: Requires AMD EPYC 3rd Gen (Milan) or newer

children.name: VM Permission Levels
children.label: CPU Support
children.description: Checks CPUID 0x8000001F EAX bit 5 for VMPL hardware support
children.fix_hint: Check for BIOS update or verify processor model

children.name: Number of VMPLs
children.label: CPU Info
children.description: Reads CPUID 0x8000001F EBX bits 15:12 for VMPL count (expected: 4)

children.name: SEV-SNP
children.message: MSR read failed: Error Reading MSR
children.label: BIOS Configured
children.description: Reads MSR 0xC0010010 (SYSCFG) bit 24 to verify SNP enabled at system level
children.fix_hint: Load MSR kernel module: sudo modprobe msr

children.name: SNP initialized
children.message: Failed to get SNP Platform status unable to open /dev/sev
children.label: Platform Initialized
children.description: Queries SNP_PLATFORM_STATUS state field = 1 (INIT state)
children.fix_hint: Run with sudo: sudo snphost ok

children.name: Read RMP tables
children.label: BIOS Configured
children.description: Reads MSRs 0xC0010132 and 0xC0010133 for RMP base/end addresses
children.fix_hint: Enable SNP Memory Coverage in BIOS. Run: sudo modprobe msr

children.name: RMP table initialized
children.label: Platform Initialized
children.description: Queries SNP platform status IS_RMP_INIT bit
children.fix_hint: Run with sudo. Need CONFIG_KVM_AMD_SEV=y. Reboot if firmware was updated

children.name: Alias check
children.label: Compliance
children.description: Queries SNP platform status ALIAS_CHECK_COMPLETE bit (CVE-2024-21944 mitigation)
children.fix_hint: Update SEV firmware and BIOS per AMD-SB-3015. Reboot required

children.name: Physical address bit reduction
children.label: CPU Info
children.description: Reads CPUID 0x8000001F EBX bits 11:6 for PA bit reduction value

children.name: C-bit location
children.label: CPU Info
children.description: Reads CPUID 0x8000001F EBX bits 5:0 for encryption bit position in page tables

children.name: Number of encrypted guests supported simultaneously
children.label: CPU Info
children.description: Reads CPUID 0x8000001F ECX for maximum encrypted guest count

children.name: Minimum ASID value for SEV-enabled, SEV-ES disabled guest
children.label: CPU Info
children.description: Reads CPUID 0x8000001F EDX for minimum SEV-only ASID value

children.name: /dev/sev readable
children.label: Platform Initialized
children.description: Attempts to open /dev/sev device for reading
children.fix_hint: Run with sudo: sudo snphost ok

children.name: /dev/sev writable
children.label: Platform Initialized
children.description: Attempts to open /dev/sev device for writing
children.fix_hint: Run with sudo: sudo snphost ok

children.name: Page flush MSR
children.label: CPU Info
children.description: Checks CPUID 0x8000001F EAX bit 2 for page flush MSR optimization support

tests.name: KVM supported
tests.label: KVM Config
tests.description: Opens /dev/kvm and queries KVM API version via ioctl
tests.fix_hint: Run with sudo: sudo snphost ok

children.name: SEV enabled in KVM
children.label: KVM Config
children.description: Reads /sys/module/kvm_amd/parameters/sev for "1" or "Y"
children.fix_hint: Set: options kvm_amd sev=1 in /etc/modprobe.d/kvm.conf

children.name: SEV-ES enabled in KVM
children.label: KVM Config
children.description: Reads /sys/module/kvm_amd/parameters/sev_es for "1" or "Y"
children.fix_hint: Set: options kvm_amd sev-es=1 in /etc/modprobe.d/kvm.conf

children.name: SEV-SNP enabled in KVM
children.label: KVM Config
children.description: Reads /sys/module/kvm_amd/parameters/sev_snp for "1" or "Y"
children.fix_hint: Set: options kvm_amd sev-snp=1 in /etc/modprobe.d/kvm.conf. Need kernel 6.11+

tests.name: Memlock resource limit
tests.label: Compliance
tests.description: Reads RLIMIT_MEMLOCK soft and hard limits via getrlimit syscall
tests.fix_hint: Set memlock unlimited: edit /etc/security/limits.conf or systemd LimitMEMLOCK=infinity

tests.name: Comparing TCB values
tests.label: Compliance
tests.description: Compares platform_tcb_version with reported_tcb_version from SNP_PLATFORM_STATUS
tests.fix_hint: Run with sudo: sudo snphost ok
